import pandas as pd
import io
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data Cleaning
df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
df[['Systolic_BP', 'Diastolic_BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Drop duplicate rows to avoid overplotting identical data points
df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9), constrained_layout=True)

# Create the main scatter plot (bubble chart)
# This plot encodes 6 variables:
# x-axis: Physical Activity Level
# y-axis: Sleep Duration
# color: Occupation
# size: Stress Level
# marker style: Sleep Disorder
# annotation: BMI Category
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Occupation',
    size='Stress Level',
    style='Sleep Disorder',
    sizes=(200, 2000),
    palette='viridis',
    ax=ax,
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8,
    s=100 # base size for legend consistency
)

# Improve the plot with titles and labels
ax.set_title('Impact of Lifestyle on Sleep Health', fontsize=20, weight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (Minutes/Day)', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=14)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)

# Add annotations for BMI Category to each point for extra insight
for i in range(df.shape[0]):
    ax.text(
        df['Physical Activity Level'][i] + 0.5,
        df['Sleep Duration'][i],
        df['BMI Category'][i],
        fontdict={'size': 11, 'weight': 'semibold', 'color': 'gray'}
    )

# Adjust legend
# Move the legend outside the plot
h, l = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate legends for clarity
legend1 = plt.legend(h[:4], l[:4], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', title='Occupation', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
ax.add_artist(legend1)
legend2 = plt.legend(h[4:9], l[4:9], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.75), loc='upper left', title='Stress Level', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
ax.add_artist(legend2)
legend3 = plt.legend(h[9:], l[9:], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.55), loc='upper left', title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')

# Set grid and spines
ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
sns.despine(ax=ax, left=True, bottom=True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
